subject: Re: Kickoff: cell painting embedding service (H1)
body:
Status: parity reached. Embeddings from our service match the published notebook to within 1e-5 on the BBBC025 sample images — same 5-stain ordering, same random projection weights, so anyone comparing against the paper gets identical vectors.

One real risk I want on the record: the NeurIPS LMRL workshop paper we published ("It's easy to fool yourself") showed exactly this class of assay is prone to batch effects and confounding — plate position and staining day leak into embeddings. If partners cluster embeddings without a batch-correction step they'll rediscover their plate layout, not biology. I'd like Amara to add a per-plate normalization option before launch review, est. 1.5 weeks.

API work on track, Giannis has the batch endpoint returning embeddings for a 384-well plate in ~4 min on 8 A100s.

Maren
